// CASE js_fn expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, options) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE js_fn_destructured expect=pass
export async function inOrderSteps(steps, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

// CASE js_arrow expect=pass
export const inOrder2 = async (items, step, { reason }) => {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
};

// CASE js_arrow_named expect=pass
const inOrder = async (items, step, _options) => {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
};

// CASE js_default expect=pass
export default async function inOrder(items, step, options) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE js_object_method expect=pass
export const sequence = {
  async inOrder(items, step, options) {
    for (const item of items) {
      await step(item);
    }
  },
};

// CASE js_impostor_extra expect=fire
export async function inOrder(items, step, options) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
    await notify(item);
  }
}

// CASE js_impostor_try expect=fire
export async function inOrder(items, step, options) {
  for (const item of items) {
    try {
      await step(item);
    } catch (error) {
      await report(error);
    }
  }
}
